candidates.change_summary: Change the deposit guard from `msg.value > MinDeposit` to `msg.value >= MinDeposit` so deposits equal to MinDeposit now update balances.
Change the guard to `msg.value > 0` so any nonzero deposit (even below MinDeposit) updates balances.
Replace the balance accumulation with an assignment so balances[msg.sender] is overwritten with msg.value instead of increased.
Credit one less than the deposited value, so balances increase by `msg.value - 1`.
Move the balances update statement to after the TransferLog.AddMessage call, so a reverting log call leaves balances unchanged.
